description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kuda Kowana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420208 (23/0350)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
